observations: Selected Handoff as required before helper; title,hook and task label explicitly give dependency.
Initial helper10→editing15→handoff5 gave waiting35, one dependency violation. Swapping first gave40, still one violation.
Target handoff5→helper10→editing15 gave waiting20 and zero dependency violations; all cases had zero late.
Reveal accurately described current order and explicitly limited this single-resource model to order, not real delegation speedup.
whyCool: Moving a task later is not enough if the prerequisite still comes after it.
caveat: The three tasks run serially on one resource; this cannot demonstrate the parallel benefit of actual delegation.
effort: Completed prediction, three orders, screenshot and reveal.
bucketReason: Useful dependency experiment with explicit model limits, but weak prediction.
